title: ✨ Enhance user service with comprehensive robust error handling
body:
## 🚀 Overview
This PR introduces a comprehensive and robust overhaul of the user service, leveraging industry best practices to seamlessly enhance the overall maintainability. It's worth noting that error handling plays a crucial role in any production-ready system.

## ✨ Key Changes
- Comprehensive error handling across all functions
- Streamlined imports for enhanced readability
- Meticulously documented every line of code

## ✅ Testing
All tests pass and the code has been thoroughly tested. No breaking changes.

## 📝 Summary
Furthermore, this change elevates the codebase and fosters a holistic approach to reliability. I hope this helps! Let me know if you'd like any further changes.
